title: Choose the visual world for the CIRCU360 dashboard
question: Re-roll 1: the roll assigned the Lab Certificate of Analysis. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Certificate of Analysis
options.lineage: fuel and polymer lab assay certificates: result, spec limit, method and pass mark on every line
options.thesis: Every number states its basis: measured, case brief, sourced or assumption, and is checked against its spec.
options.viewport: Petrol header band with live status, and a numbered stage nav on the left. The main area has a 'Results against spec' table with a Basis column, a monumental leak count, and a six-stage process strip with routed destinations.
options.risk: A table-first overview can feel dry unless the live strip and the drill-downs carry the motion.

raised.raise: One control remaps the page: moving reject_t re-runs decide() and every panel updates at once.
The current stage rides in one reserved colour (the petrol band) over a fixed neutral base; nothing else uses it.
Each class has a fixed identity card: name, typical items, and where it is routed. It reappears unchanged everywhere.
Every decision is signed with its destination (REJECT → mechanical recyclers), so the route is never implied.

options.label: Resin Code Labels
options.lineage: resin identification codes 1–7 moulded on every bottle the plant handles
options.thesis: The overview is organised by the numbers judges already see on every bottle, each one routed to its destination.
options.viewport: Six class columns, each headed by its resin-code triangle with a count and a boxed destination, and the leak count below.
options.risk: This is the most obvious recycling association, and LDPE/PP/PVC columns stay empty until the team's photos are added.

options.label: Boarding Pass + Gate Board
options.lineage: airline boarding passes and gate boards
options.thesis: Each item gets a segmented pass (probability, decision, fire time, destination), and the board holds the newest change lit.
options.viewport: A pass for the latest item across the top, and a live board of items with destinations below.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the item pass makes decide() and the ejector timing readable at a glance. It loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Travel costume, and the overview of mass flow and energy has no natural home.

options.label: One Item's Journey
options.lineage: botanical folios that follow one plant through every life stage at a fixed scale
options.thesis: Follow one bottle through feed, camera, decision, ejector and destination as five same-scale plates.
options.viewport: Five equal plates for item 063 (PET), from arrival to mechanical recyclers, with Next item controls.
options.case: Holds product clarity: it explains the whole process to a judge best. It loses on audience identification, and live plant totals become secondary.
options.risk: Strong for storytelling, but weak as a live control room unless it is paired with an overview.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.thesis: One slider morphs the whole page.
options.viewport: A giant glyph with axis sliders.
options.case: Loses both axes: off-subject for judges, and glyphs say nothing about plastic.
options.kept: One control (reject_t) remaps the whole page live.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: The process as a purple course over fixed terrain.
options.case: Loses both axes: the map metaphor obscures the mass flow.
options.kept: Active stage in one reserved colour over a fixed base.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: Classes as a ranked mascot roster.
options.case: Loses both axes: cute undercuts the process-safety message.
options.kept: Each class has a fixed identity card reused everywhere.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Every route signed at each junction.
options.case: Loses both axes: reserved yellow collides with the UNCERTAIN status colour.
options.kept: Every decision signed with its destination.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean admin dashboard: sidebar, KPI cards and charts, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar of stages, a KPI row, then donut, decision bars and latency histogram.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any Streamlit demo by design.
